capture.retry_observability: not recorded separately by the collector; final failed pages=0

method.gap: (next_open - prior_close) / prior_close; only adjacent valid rows exactly 900000 ms apart
method.percentile: nearest-rank ascending adverse nonzero gaps; rank=ceil(0.99*N)
method.data_quality: invalid OHLC/time rows skipped; duplicate open times deduplicated; gaps in timestamp grid break the adjacent-pair calculation
